headline: Spaniards, under Sánchez, increasingly poor: CPI soars 4.9% in September... and 28.7% since 2018
summary: Spanish consumer prices rose 4.9% in September, mainly due to higher prices for fuels and lubricants for personal vehicles. The increase was cited by the national statistics institute.
why: Consumer price inflation guides central bank rate decisions and bond yield expectations, and fuel prices feed into household costs across the economy.
